name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump says the U.S. will collect tolls and impose blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, man killed by federal agents in Maine, states sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros merger.

changes.title: More extreme heat across parts of U.S.
changes.summary: CBS News meteorologist Rob Marciano tracks high temperatures across parts of the U.S.

changes.title: Cyclosporiasis Outbreaks Hits More Than Half of the US
changes.summary: Cases of a severe stomach bug called Cyclosporiasis are surging across the United States, sickening thousands of Americans and even sending some to the hospital. NBC’s medical contributor Dr. John Torress joins TODAY to break down the symptoms and how you can stay safe.

changes.title: Trump Says U.S. Will ‘Take Over’ Strait of Hormuz, and How Russia Made Japan a Den of Spies
changes.summary: Plus, scientists find sugar in outer space.

changes.title: U.S. Workers Are More Productive Than Ever. A.I. Isn’t the Key.
changes.summary: Companies have been getting more out of employees for several years. Tight labor markets, digitization and remote work are among the reasons.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday announced a reversal of plans to charge a 20% toll on cargo going through the Strait of Hormuz, saying that Middle Eastern countries will instead make investment and trade deals with the U.S.

changes.title: Europe, Flexing Muscle in Ukraine, Is Still on Sidelines in Iran
changes.summary: In a show of collective strength, President Emmanuel Macron of France hosted European allies at the annual Bastille Day parade in Paris. Yet Europe is still a hostage to America’s foreign policy.

changes.title: Some international artists are skipping U.S. tours. Others may follow suit
changes.summary: The visa process for visiting artists has always been complicated and expensive. Under the current administration, it's gotten significantly worse.

changes.title: In the aftermath of deadly shootings, ICE pauses most traffic stops
changes.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement will pause non-urgent vehicle stops after two deadly shootings in less than a week, Maine U.S. Sen. Angus King's office tells NPR. (Image credit: Joseph Prezioso).

changes.title: VLA sky survey sets new standard for high-resolution, wide-area radio astronomy
changes.summary: The U.S. National Science Foundation National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NSF NRAO) has completed observations for the Very Large Array Sky Survey (VLASS), the most detailed radio survey of the sky ever conducted, providing an unprecedented view of the dynamic radio universe.
